name: span_isSubDPIdeal_iff
statement: Set A} (hS : S ⊆ I) : IsSubDPIdeal hI (span S) ↔ ∀ {n : ℕ} (_ : n ≠ 0), ∀ s ∈ S, hI.dpow n s ∈ span S

name: dpow_mem_span_of_mem_span
statement: Set A} (hS : S ⊆ I) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {z : A} (hz : z ∈ span {y : A | ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : n ≠ 0) (x : A) (_ : x ∈ S), y = hI.dpow n x}) : hI.dpow k z ∈ span {y : A | ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : n ≠ 0) (x : A) (_ : x ∈ S), y = hI.dpow n x}

name: span_carrier_eq_dpow_span
statement: Set A} (hS : S ⊆ I) : (SubDPIdeal.span hI S).carrier = span {y : A | ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : n ≠ 0) (x : A) (_ : x ∈ S), y = hI.dpow n x}
